As Public Storage (PSA) Market Valuation Declined, Epoch Investment Partners Has Boosted Position; As Boeing Co (BA) Share Price Rose, Nli International Lifted Position
May 2, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Nli International Inc increased its stake in Boeing Co (BA) by 8.68% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nli International Inc bought 2,740 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.82% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 34,320 shares of the aerospace company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.12M, up from 31,580 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nli International Inc who had been investing in Boeing Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $191.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.95% or $3.1152 during the last trading session, reaching $326.4248. About 987,616 shares traded. The Boeing Company (NYSE:BA) has risen 82.35% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 70.80% the S&P500.
Epoch Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Public Storage (PSA) by 2.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Epoch Investment Partners Inc bought 13,930 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 643,426 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $134.48 million, up from 629,496 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Epoch Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Public Storage for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.43B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.53% or $1.08 during the last trading session, reaching $203.42. About 222,095 shares traded. Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has declined 10.33% since May 2, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.88% the S&P500.
Since February 8, 2018, it had 0 buys, and 1 sale for $12.17 million activity.
